protocol.comparison: Identical frozen XGBoost bytes and tier rules; baseline inputs versus an append-only overlay of audited post-2019 manual district months. Environmental definitions and training-period inputs must be identical.
protocol.target_policy: Only source-marked genuine district-month depths. Both versions and baselines use identical district/origin/horizon/target values; current-origin-month groundwater is unavailable until the next month.
protocol.calibration: 90th percentile absolute residual (higher empirical quantile) by actual serving tier and horizon. No borrowing from evaluation or final labels; unsupported horizons retain unavailable ranges.
protocol.selection: Retain the appended-data forecast as an experimental candidate if pooled development MAE is no greater than unchanged-input MAE. This decision is frozen before final evaluation. Final labels only report performance, never tune or select. Data acquisition and integrity fixes are retained independently of forecast selection.
protocol.geographic_checks: Pseudo-cold reference excludes all target history and never invokes the XGBoost artifact. A sensitivity excludes every target-state district from the donor panel. Natural sparse subsets use actual observed count <=23; no hidden target history is used to fit a transfer model.
protocol.uncertainty: Report empirical interval coverage and sample counts. Nominal 90% is a calibration quantile, not a validated per-district probability.
limitations: Retrospective conditional-on-observation-date replay: provider publication-time snapshots are unavailable.
Calendar holdout is protected within this experiment, but source distributions and the original model were inspected previously; this is not blind prospective validation.
District station panels, well identities and aquifer datums may differ. New district means do not establish identical-well changes.
Temporal cases share districts and overlapping targets; counts are not independent sample sizes.
Cold-start reference evaluation does not confer spatial independence on the already-trained XGBoost artifact.
No new pooled learner, hydrogeological transfer model, hyperparameter search or model refit is justified without consistent predictors and separate training/calibration evidence.

frozen_compatibility.policy: Same immutable model weights; only post-training missing groundwater months added with unchanged physical-v3 rules.
